name: DataForSEO
description: DataForSEO provides a comprehensive suite of SEO and digital marketing data via APIs and databases, including real-time SERP, keyword, backlinks, on-page, domain analytics, reviews, merchant, app, social, and content analysis data. Built for developers, SEO platforms, and marketing teams to power rank tracking, keyword research, competitor analysis, reputation monitoring, and ecommerce intelligence with pay-as-you-go pricing, extensive documentation, and 24/7 support.
